title: Controlplane + Routing + Auth: Open Questions Clinic
content:
Date: 2027-01-25
Facilitator: Priya Nair
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Sofia, Kenji, Avery, Raul (SRE), Maya (Solutions Eng) 
Duration: 45m
Location: Zoom / #pltfm-controlplane

Purpose: Quick clinic to surface open design questions across control plane, routing, auth, and quota subsystems that block small rollouts. Goal was to leave with clear owners and first concrete experiments, not to finalize long-term designs.

SUMMARY / TL;DR
- Routing fallback semantics: agreed on short-term pragmatic behavior and added follow-up to make it observable. (owner: Ethan / PLT-4031)
- Auth token rotation edge-case during canary rollouts remains unresolved; Kenji will prototype coordination pattern w/ kv-store lease.
- Quota burst smoothing: basic leaky-bucket patch approved for next deploy window; integration tests required. (owner: Sofia)
- Control plane hitch observed at ~2400 rps during version sync; SRE to collect traces and spool a micro-repro. (owner: Raul)

NOTES (raw, conversational)
00:00 - kickoff: Priya: "This is a clinic, not a design review — bring the worst open Qs and we'll unstick one or two."
00:03 - Ethan: routing fallback behavior when model variant is missing mid-request. Current behavior returns 503 and client retries; that causes client-side latency spikes. Proposal A: server redirects to compatible lower-tier model variant and stream a warning. Proposal B: pre-reserve fallback routing at allocation time and refuse new requests if fallback capacity not available.
    - Discussion: Pros/cons of A vs B. A is fast to implement (adapter layer) but can change returned token distribution; B is safer for deterministic SLAs but causes more failures.
    - Decision (short-term): implement A for hosted tier with a feature flag; add audit event and per-request header indicating fallback used. Create an alert on sudden increase in fallback-rate. (Ethan -> PLT-4031)

00:12 - Kenji: auth token rotation + canary handoff. Problem: when control plane moves traffic between canary and stable, token rotation sometimes invalidates short-lived per-route keys causing Oauth failures for ~5s. We saw this in last Thursday's canary for esp route.
    - Brainstorms: central lease coordination (kv-store) vs. sequence-numbered key envelopes that remain valid for X sec after rotation. Central lease simplifies but adds availability dependency. Sequence numbers require careful cleanup.
    - Action: Kenji to prototype a lease-based coordination with a TTL of 15s and a fast-retry path. If prototype shows <50ms median extra latency and no extra failure modes, we'll adopt for next canary. Add an SLO spike detection for token auth failures.

00:23 - Sofia: quotas / burst smoothing. Observed short bursts from customer tests that exceed per-second quota but are within minute window -> causing unfair throttles and head-of-line blocking. Proposed leak-bucket with per-customer reservoir + local graceful queuing.
    - Experiment plan: add reservoir size = rate * 5s, leaky drain calibrated to steady-state rate. If bucket empty, soft-queue up to 200ms before rejecting. Measure p95 latency and rejection rate.
    - Decision: greenlight experiment on dev cluster. Sofia will own test harness and add synthetic traffic generator. (Sofia -> PLT-4078)

00:32 - Control plane sync hitch. Raul: during a mass model version roll-forward we saw 2s hitch at 2400rps. Traces show a synchronous disk wait inside the model cache invalidation routine.
    - Immediate mitigation: stagger version syncs across shards (30s jitter). Longer-term: make invalidation async and incremental.
    - Action: Raul to collect flamegraphs and attach to PLT-4102. Priya to coordinate a small rollback if we see this again in next canary.

00:38 - Cross-cutting: observability and perf dashboards. Maya emphasized that teams need per-route "fallback used" metric + auth-rotation-failures metric. Add both to console and tie to a short alert runbook.
    - Owners: Ethan (fallback metric) + Kenji (auth failure metric). Dashboard templating to be delivered as a console widget.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS (to triage in follow-ups)
- How to present fallback semantics to customers programmatically? header vs. explicit metadata in response payload. (product input needed)
- Is 15s lease TTL for auth rotation safe across multi-region failovers? Kenji to simulate.
- Do we need per-model-variant warm-pools to reduce fallbacks? cost tradeoff discussion required.

DECISIONS MADE (short list)
- Implement server-side fallback to compatible model variant behind FF for hosted tier (Ethan). Audit events + alert on fallback-rate increase.
- Approve leaky-bucket burst smoothing experiment on dev cluster (Sofia).
- Stagger version syncs with jitter as immediate mitigation (Raul).

ACTION ITEMS (owner -> ticket / eta)
- Ethan Moore -> PLT-4031: routing fallback implementation + audit events + console metric. ETA: 2027-02-08.
- Kenji Watanabe -> PLT-4120: prototype auth-lease coordination + perf checks + multi-region sim. ETA: 2027-02-11.
- Sofia Alvarez -> PLT-4078: implement quota reservoir + queuing experiment + integration tests. ETA: 2027-02-04.
- Raul (SRE) -> PLT-4102: traces/flamegraphs for version-sync hitch + actionable mitigation plan. ETA: 2027-01-29.
- Maya (Solutions Eng) -> add regression test in customer-sim harness for mixed-rate traffic scenarios. ETA: 2027-02-03.
- Priya Nair -> PLT-4155: create docs stub for "fallback semantics" + customer-facing wording draft. ETA: 2027-02-10.

FOLLOW-UP SESSIONS
- Mini sync (15m) next Friday 2027-01-29 to review traces from Raul and decide go/no-go for jitter rollout.
- Full clinic in two weeks (2027-02-08) to review Ethan prototype + Sofia experiment results.

NOTES TO SELF (Priya)
- Remember to copy decisions into the Control Plane RFC backlog and link to the console widget ticket.
- Push for product to pick a default customer-visible behavior (header vs payload) before broad rollout.

ATTACHMENTS / REFERENCES
- Recent incident: #incident-2027-01-21-auth-canary (Slack thread)
- Ticket PLT-4031 (routing fallback)
- Draft playbook: Quota Routing Playbook (Confluence link above)
- PR with related changes: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1824

END OF NOTES

(These notes are intentionally a mix of shorthand and action-oriented items; please tidy for the RFC if you are picking up an action.)
